newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Soros reduces stake in Sydney Casino.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Soros reduces stake in Sydney Casino.

text.p: The funds of international investor George Soros said on Thursday they had reduced their stake in Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd to 7.62 percent from 8.65 percent.

Various Soros funds, including Soros Capital and the Quantum funds, said the holding in the casino had been reduced from 32.583 million shares to 29.552 million shares in trades between August 20 and November 8.
Sydney Harbour Casino, 26.3 percent owned by Showboat Inc, has been the subject of heavy trade in recent days, including turnover of 11 million shares on Wednesday.
